WITH claim_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve
    FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_amount AS ca
    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.loss_payment AS lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.loss_reserve AS lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.expense_payment AS ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.expense_reserve AS er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
paid_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM acme_insurance.main.policy_amount AS pa
    JOIN acme_insurance.main.premium AS pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_parties AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier,
        apr.Party_Identifier,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', person.First_Name, person.Last_Name)), ''),
            org.Organization_Name,
            CAST(party.Party_Name AS VARCHAR)
        ) AS Party_Name,
        apr.Party_Role_Code,
        role.Party_Role_Name
    FROM acme_insurance.main.agreement_party_role AS apr
    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.party AS party
        ON party.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.person AS person
        ON person.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.organizations AS org
        ON org.Organization_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.party_role AS role
        ON role.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    COALESCE(ct.loss_payment, 0) AS loss_payment,
    COALESCE(ct.loss_reserve, 0) AS loss_reserve,
    COALESCE(ct.expense_payment, 0) AS expense_payment,
    COALESCE(ct.expense_reserve, 0) AS expense_reserve,
    pp.premium_amount_paid,
    holder.Party_Identifier AS policy_holder_identifier,
    holder.Party_Name AS policy_holder,
    agent.Party_Identifier AS agent_identifier,
    agent.Party_Name AS agent
FROM acme_insurance.main.claim AS c
JOIN acme_insurance.main.claim_coverage AS cc

JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy_coverage_detail AS pcd

   AND pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy AS p

LEFT JOIN claim_totals AS ct

LEFT JOIN paid_premiums AS pp

LEFT JOIN policy_parties AS holder

LEFT JOIN policy_parties AS agent

   )
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, c.Claim_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, p.Policy_Identifier

    SELECT

    FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_amount AS ca

    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.expense_reserve AS er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier

claim_policies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_coverage AS cc
    JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
      ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier

),
premiums AS (
    SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM acme_insurance.main.policy_amount AS pa
    JOIN acme_insurance.main.premium AS pr
      ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_parties AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        string_agg(
            DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(role.Party_Role_Name, apr.Party_Role_Code)), '[^a-z]', '', 'g') LIKE '%policyholder%'
                THEN cast(apr.Party_Identifier AS VARCHAR) || ': ' ||
                     coalesce(nullif(trim(concat_ws(' ', pe.First_Name, pe.Last_Name)), ''), org.Organization_Name, cast(pt.Party_Name AS VARCHAR))
            END,
            ', '
        ) AS policy_holder,
        string_agg(
            DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN lower(coalesce(role.Party_Role_Name, apr.Party_Role_Code)) LIKE '%agent%'
                THEN cast(apr.Party_Identifier AS VARCHAR) || ': ' ||
                     coalesce(nullif(trim(concat_ws(' ', pe.First_Name, pe.Last_Name)), ''), org.Organization_Name, cast(pt.Party_Name AS VARCHAR))
